general_notes: Each state contains the same pattern of candidates: (1) the target inset in a flat border (practically identical); (2) four dark-round-vignette app presentations of the full figure, practically identical to each other with small spark/smoke/wisp variations (depleted C has visibly thinner smoke; joyful D has fewer sparks); (3) one tight zoomed crop in a vignette that cuts off legs and lower body; (4) one heavily blurred copy of the target; (5) one smooth 3D/vector re-creation that is a clearly different character and style. The vignette presentations keep the character faithful but replace the painted warm background, floor light and signature with darkness, which I scored under P2-P4. The depleted target itself contains a grey rectangular patch near the feet that looks like an artefact; the vignette versions hide it. The motion sequences differ only by framing (full figure versus zoomed crop) and by local flicker of flames, sparks and smoke. No sequence shows body motion (breathing, bounce, sway), so expressiveness is limited, especially for joyful and fierce. With only six still frames per loop I cannot judge temporal smoothness or looping seams, so A1/A3 are moderate-confidence estimates. Distinguishing among the near-identical vignette candidates is at the limit of what I could see at this resolution.
